about: Labelled evaluation set for matching. Each vacancy carries the label a careful recruiter would give for each synthetic candidate (beginner, career_changer, mid, senior): 'recommend' (show it as a match), 'check' (show it under Needs checking only), 'out' (leave it out, with a reason). Labels were written by reading the vacancy and the CVs, not by running the code. Candidates live in the Netherlands and can work there; remote preferred, hybrid fine, never fully in the office.
